1.c4 e5 2.e3 d6 3.Nc3 Nc6 4.b3.strategy: Prepares the queen's bishop on the long diagonal. For now the knight on c3 stands in front of it, so the bishop only pressures e5 once that knight moves. A modest, flexible plan: White develops safely without challenging Black's centre.

1.c4 e5 2.e3 d6 3.Nc3 Nc6 4.b3 Nf6.strategy: Completes the development of both knights and takes control of e4 and d5, so White's e-pawn cannot advance for free. Black has a solid, flexible set-up with the centre held and no weaknesses.
1.c4 e5 2.e3 d6 3.Nc3 Nc6 4.b3 Nf6.name: Amsterdam Attack
